# Rotor-drag go/no-go (Q6; generated by `python tools/drag_fit.py --render`; do not edit by hand)

Model: horizontal body specific force f = -k v + c, v = ground-truth body velocity. OFFLINE analysis; the estimator never reads ground truth.

Pre-registered rule (16 Nov 2026, before real data): with 1 s smoothing and ground-truth accel bias removed, GO if for both horizontal axes k (first half) > 0, held-out R^2 on the second half >= 0.5 (first-half k, offset refitted), and second-half k within 30 % of first-half k.

They never change the pre-registered decision; switching V3 on would need a new rule fixed in advance and tested on sequences not used here.
